name: traces
description: The tool-call index: one row per tool_use_id from every session, kept by the tracer Stop hook's one-shot and read by `ak tracer calls` (hoisted: `ak trace`). dist/traces.mjs is the only artefact a user runs.
link:dev-why: MONOREPO PERIOD ONLY. The sources import nothing but node:*; the one package here is esbuild, for the build. node_modules is a relative SYMLINK to a sibling checkout's node_modules (gitignored, recreated by `npm run link:dev`) rather than a second install, so every bundle in the checkout builds with the same esbuild and a freshness check compares like with like.
